map.功率为什么用 10 倍对数？: Why does power use a factor of 10 in the logarithm?
map.分贝本质是功率比的对数（贝尔的 10 倍），声功率、电功率等能量量都用 10·l: A decibel is fundamentally 10 times the logarithm of a power ratio; sound power, electrical power and other energy quantities all use 10·log10.
map.和电压 dB 有何不同？: How does it differ from voltage dB?
map.电压/声压与功率的平方根相关，故用 20·log10；同一比值下电压 dB 是功: Voltage and sound pressure relate to the square root of power, hence 20·log10; for the same ratio the voltage dB is twice the power dB.
